sourceTitle: Foster carer payments and allowances (Rochdale Borough Council)
feesNote: Rochdale pays a weekly fee to the carer on top of the child's basic maintenance allowance; the level, from 2 to 3, is discussed during assessment and confirmed after approval at fostering panel.
extras: Birthday allowance worth one week's basic maintenance allowance
Festival allowance worth one week's basic maintenance allowance
Holiday allowance once a year, worth two weeks' basic maintenance allowance
summary: Rochdale pays a basic maintenance allowance for each child across four age bands, plus a weekly fee for the carer at Level 2 or the higher Level 3. The council's page does not state which year the rates apply to, so we have listed them under the current financial year; check the latest figures with Rochdale's fostering team.
